## Variables

Density by stage:

+ $E$ - density of eggs

+ $L_1$ - density of first instar larvae

+ $L_2$ - density of second instar larvae

+ $L_3$ - density of third instar larvae

+ $L_4$ - density of fourth instar larvae

+ $P$ - density of pupae 

Let $L$ denote our index of mean crowding:

$$L = w_1 L_1 + w_2 L_2 + w_3 L_3 + L_4$$ 
## Parameters

The parameters describe:

+ $\psi_i$ -- maturation, by stage

+ $\xi_i$ -- larval instar maturation delay in response to mean crowding

+ $\phi_i$ -- density independent mortality, by stage

+ $\theta_i$ -- increased mortality in response to mean crowding

+ $w_i$ contribution by stage to mean crowding, relative to $L_4$ 

The derivatives are: 

$$
\begin{array}{rl}
dE/dt & = \eta -  \psi_E E - \phi_E E  \\
dL_1/dt  &=  \psi_E E - \psi_1 L e^{-\xi_1 L} - (\phi_1 + \theta_1 L) L_1 \\
dL_2/dt &=  \psi_1 L_1 e^{-\xi_1 L} - \psi_2 L e^{-\xi_2 L} - (\phi_2 + \theta_2 L) L_2 \\
dL_3/dt  &=  \psi_2 L_2 e^{-\xi_2 L}- \psi_3 L e^{-\xi_3 L} - (\phi_3 + \theta_3 L) L_3 \\
dL_4/dt  &=  \psi_3 L_3 e^{-\xi_3 L}- \psi_4 L e^{-\xi_4 L} - (\phi_4 + \theta_4 L) L_4 \\
dP/dt  &= \psi_4 L_4 e^{-\xi_4 L}- \phi_P P - \psi_P P \\ 
\end{array}
$$

$$
F_\alpha = \psi_P P
$$
